notes.title: 0.52xx major version update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/16c14c88e4339f01d13838d825b3e6ea469cbc09.jpg

Dear players, since the game was released two months ago, we have received a lot of feedback. We apologize for not providing you with a good experience due to bugs, performance, operation, difficulty, and other issues.
In these two months, although the sales have been very poor, we are still putting in the last bit of resources and time to optimize updates.
In addition to fixing bugs and optimizing performance, we have compiled a relatively large adjustment update based on everyone's feedback, as follows:
Important!! Archive compatibility issue: Due to our remake of the cooking and physique system, the old archive will convert data and the physique will be adjusted to the initial value upon entry.
If you cannot accept it, you can continue running the previous version of the game and choose to do so at startup.
Sorry for any inconvenience caused to you!
1、 The difficulty selection function, in order to meet the needs of different types of players, we have set three levels of difficulty: casual, normal, and difficult. We hope it will be helpful for your gaming experience.
2、 Remake the nutritional system, food buff, and cooking system! Reduce the cost of understanding ingredients and highlight their effectiveness.
3、 Basic interaction optimization, reducing the switching of basic operation buttons, and avoiding E, Misoperation of F key.
4、 Add character information UI and process chain UI, and integrate them with "make", "build", and "help" UI into a large UI.
V Remake NPC upgrade system and add NPC upgrade cultivation line.
6、 Remove the wooden card teleportation function and switch to the Earth Monument teleportation, which can be teleported between the Earth Temple and can be teleported back to the Earth Monument at any location.
7、 Map UI Tag Filter

*8、 Server (simplified version)
Currently, a simplified version of the server has been released, which can be used to improve the issue of low host frame rates when multiple people are online
Usage:
1. Open the server directory and run: Game installation directory/Server/PathlessWoodsServer.exe
2. Create a game after running the server
3. After running the game itself, connect to the server by joining the game
4. At present, the server version has relatively rudimentary functions, which are only suitable for local operation and not suitable for being placed on cloud servers. We will continue to improve the functions in the future.

This is what our small team is currently trying to do to the best of our ability. If there is anything else that makes you very uncomfortable, you can contact us again. We are very sorry, and we will continue to update you continuously in the future.

Email: qyz@aniya.games    alex0524824@126.com

notes.title: Pathless Woods Dev Update: Optimizing The Building System!
notes.notes:
Hey Settlers! 

As we continue to develop Pathless Woods, we would like to connect and give you a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Pathless Woods through our dev updates!

In this dev update, we'd like to share with you about what we've been working on recently - optimizing the building construction system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/51029c6ced873d6edeb297d6985aaec8b2af691a.png

If you were previously involved in our closed beta, you would have noticed that there were some issues in the original building construction system such as not having a proper auto-align mode and frequent misalignment issues where players could only use the lines on the ground as a reference for building. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/bc4b0242a09541fec40e6ce60c826abe55f1d6ab.gif

With Pathless Woods being a game that allows for extensive building and crafting, it was crucial for us to ensure that each building part type had its own specific alignment rules and designs. As such, we have improved the auto-align mode of the building construction system to ensure a smooth experience for players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/4306442838063dac14c90b824e03478bef53c041.png

With these improvements, building on uneven terrain and adding tiles to roofs will be easier and more precise, allowing players to express their creativity and build their own world without limits. No more worrying about "shaky hands" ruining your creations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/037910bb1f5dae2a477bbbb4e33fe858dd72bfdb.png

As we continue on our journey to make the Pathless Woods gaming experience better for everyone, the next steps ahead for us would be focusing on updating the in-game interaction interface and adding new and exciting features. Although we can't reveal all the details just yet, we are confident that the improvements we are making to the interface and character movements will result in a more convenient and immersive experience for players.

And with that, we wrap up this installment of our development progress for Pathless Woods! We would love to hear from you and know what else you're curious about in our game. Feel free to reach out to us through various channels, and we'll be happy to answer any questions you may have!

Pathless Woods Twitter
Pathless Woods Discord
